message.content: {"verdict":"accept","score":0.85,"reasons":["The artifact delivers a concrete engineering plan with prioritized tasks (Instrumentation & baseline capture; CI automation; Quick third‑party wins; Feature flagging & A/B; Monitoring, alerts & rollout).","It lists concrete required code and infra changes (Instrumentation in web-vitals, a GitHub Actions workflow for Lighthouse/axe, and a feature-flag toggle) with explicit examples.","A reproducible prototype is included (a small metric aggregation prototype to compute medians/75th percentiles from Lighthouse JSON outputs) and there are explicit instructions to reproduce and measure impact.","The testing plan is concrete (unit tests for parsers, integration tests via CI, staging A/B with thresholds).","Rollout and rollback plans are detailed (canary, ramp, auto-rollback thresholds; explicit rollback steps).","The document references concrete data collection and analysis steps (RUM metrics, BigQuery extracts/skeleton queries) and provides a practical path to measure improvements."],"guidance":""}
